title: Must, Must Not, and Because
label: ch:mr-must-must-not-and-because
canDo: I can say what someone must do (jāylā pāhije) and shouldn't do (jāū nayes), give a reason with -muḷe and kāraṇ, and read and write ञ in jñān.

payoff.summary: Complete MR-R281-advice-and-reasons: give advice and reasons, after meeting ज्ञान and its letter ञ.
